# Test fixtures

`peer-index.tiny-agents.fixture.json` is a **hand-written** peer index used only to exercise peer-index resolution in
the Skills registry tests. It was **not** produced by the Tiny Agents registry and its digests are placeholders.
A real peer index from the peer registry is still required before cross-registry resolution can be claimed
(Protocol v0.2 section 13, adoption test 5).
